verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents user-defined rules for automatic error assignment (docs-2). Event-driven actions are also documented: PagerDuty incidents created on error activity (docs-9), webhooks fired as soon as events are processed (docs-10), and Slack/Teams alerts (docs-7, docs-8). However, the evidence shows no general-purpose rules engine; rule-based automation appears limited to assignment, with integration-specific notification triggers alongside it. Missing for 10: a general configurable condition-to-action rules engine, documentation of rule conditions and filters for alerts and integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
